name: Pocket World
description: They pull a whole miniature street out of their jacket pocket and set it down.
camera: Slow push-in on the character {place}, framed from the waist up.

beats.action: The character reaches into a pocket and slowly pulls out a tiny, perfectly detailed living street, with little lit windows and cars moving on it, resting on their open palm.
They lift it toward the lens. The camera pushes in until the tiny street fills the frame, with tiny cars passing and tiny people walking.
A tiny copy of the character on that street looks up and waves at the camera.

product: One of the product items sits on the tiny street like a giant monument.
sound: soft cloth rustle, tiny traffic and distant city ambience growing as the camera gets closer, a warm music box.
